affectedRule: Stock Tangle Weed special 253 condition resolution

castle.observation: Castle stores spell.special as unsigned char, converts it to a short with abs, and sends every special above 99 to condition[special - 101]. Stock special 253 therefore addresses condition slot 152 outside the forty-slot array instead of applying Tangle. The neighboring condition contract identifies special 3 as condition slot 2, Entangled.

playerFacingProblem: Casting the authored stock Tangle Weed can write outside combatant condition state instead of applying its named condition, risking corrupt state or a crash while leaving the spell unusable for deterministic parity.
chosenBehavior: Preserve authored special 253 in immutable package content and behavior signatures, but normalize that otherwise impossible condition reference to special 3 at the combat-condition boundary. Every legal casting source then uses the ordinary target-type-3 area, queue, defense, duration, movement, save, and automation contracts.
